claims.evidence: Witness report describes thick, knobby tires with visible tread.
Witness only notes a headlight/reflector area and training-wheel support; no list of accessories included or missing parts.

risks.risk: Wheel size unknown (16/18/20 inches etc.), which strongly affects fit and resale value in Lagos for kids bikes.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the wheel size marking on the tire sidewall (e.g., 16/18/20) or a tape-measure photo from axle to axle/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for resale (assume smaller/less desirable size or uncertain fit) and treat as basic kids bike.

risks.risk: Brake type/condition not shown; worn pads/cables or weak braking can make it unsafe and reduce price.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear brakes (caliper/lever area), brake pads/cable condition, and a short clip showing the brakes engaging firmly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as-is with brakes potentially needing service (assume average wear).

risks.risk: Drivetrain/chain condition and shifting not shown; rusted chain or worn sprockets reduces value.
risks.proof: Photo of the chain and cassette/sprockets plus a clip of shifting through gears (if any) or pedaling smoothly (if single-speed).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic bike with possible drivetrain wear (assume needs cleaning/lube).

risks.risk: Frame damage (cracks/dents/repairs) not shown; structural issues can make it unsellable or require major repair.
risks.proof: Full-frame walkaround photos from multiple angles, especially around joints, head tube, and seat tube; include any dents/cracks clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for condition (assume minor wear only, but no guarantee of no damage).

risks.risk: Tire condition details beyond tread not shown (sidewall damage, tubed vs tubeless, punctures).
risks.proof: Close-up of both tires’ sidewalls and tread, plus a photo showing whether tires are tubed (valve) and any visible puncture/patching.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires may need replacement soon if sidewall damage/punctures exist.

risks.risk: Training wheels mounting/adjustability not confirmed; loose or misaligned training wheels reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photo showing the training-wheel brackets and adjustment points, plus a clip showing they are secure and aligned.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if training wheels are present but may require tightening/adjustment.

risks.risk: “Complete accessories” may be overstated; missing bell, reflectors, kickstand, pump, or tools affects value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included accessory (bell, reflectors, kickstand, pump, tools) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bike only (no accessories assumed) until the accessory list is verified.

proof_requests: Show the wheel size marking on the tire sidewall (or a measurement photo).
Close-ups of front and rear brakes (pads/cables) and a short braking test clip.
Photos of chain and sprockets/cassette; include a pedaling + shifting (or smooth single-speed) clip.
Full-frame photos from multiple angles to check for cracks/dents/repairs.
Close-ups of tire sidewalls and tread; confirm tubed vs tubeless (valve photo).
Photos of training-wheel brackets showing they are secure and adjustable.
Lay out and photograph all included accessories to confirm what “complete” means.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a kids bicycle with thick knobby tires and training-wheel support, which is enough to price at a worst-case condition level; however, accessories and key safety/fit details are not fully verifiable remotely, so the price should assume possible missing items and typical wear until proof is provided.
